tools.name: project_memory
tools.description:
What Diastella knows about a project: its systems (the parts of the code), how many past bug reports each has
    and how many other systems depend on it. Start here to learn the system names the other tools take.
    `repository` is a public GitHub repository as owner/name.

tools.name: similar_past_failures
tools.description:
Has this happened in this project before? Past bug reports closest to the described problem (by meaning and by
    words), each with the merged change that fixed it: the files that change touched, who wrote it, and links to both
    on GitHub. Describe the symptom or paste the error message as `prob

tools.name: known_upstream_bug
tools.description:
Is this failure a known bug in a library the project depends on? The cause of a failure is sometimes not in the
    repository in front of you but in a dependency, already reported there and in many cases already fixed. Describe the symptom
    or paste the error message as `problem`; optionally nam

tools.name: check_my_change
tools.description:
Ask this after editing and before committing: does this change undo a past fix? Give the change as a unified
    diff (the output of `git diff`). For every past fix (a merged change that closed a bug report) whose lines the
    diff removes or rewrites, returns the fix, the bug report it closed, how

tools.name: system_history
tools.description:
Everything remembered about one system of a project: its most recent past failures with their fixes and the files
    those fixes changed, who wrote the fixes, who has changed the system most, what depends on it and what it depends
    on. `system` is a name from project_memory.
